+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Replace every pair of table (see _replace_table) in s, in table order.
+    A pair whose code points do not both occur in s cannot match, so its
+    full scan is skipped: have is a superset of the code points of s (a
+    replacement only adds its new code point; removals are not tracked).
+    """
+    have = set(s)
+    add = have.add
+    for a, b, ps, c in table:
+        if a in have and b in have:
+            t = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if t is not s:
+                add(c)
+                s = t
+    return s
+
